summary: Reproduced the distinct UniversalCopy128b load and UniversalAtomicAdd store cases. A one-tile, per-thread register fragment with layout (4,2):(1,4) is valid input to retile: it contains the required eight contiguous values, but retile incorrectly sent it through a residual-tile path and aborted in intTupleZip2By. The fix directly repartitions such one-tile fragments by the consumer atom value layout. Copying the fragment without retile is invalid because source and destination have incompatible value-group counts (2 versus 8); CopyOp now reports that contract violation rather than silently emitting an incomplete copy. The explicit make_view workaround remains valid.

Independent CPU float64 reference -99.932795524247922 versus GPU float32 -99.932807922363281 (absolute error 1.23981154e-05). Final LLVM IR contains 16 atomicrmw fadd operations and final gfx950 ISA contains 16 global_atomic_cmpswap instructions.
